_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: The Dec 2020 analog and current momentum/ETF tailwinds suggest eventual upward resolution, but the coil is incomplete — capital deployment has not shifted from fear-hedge (gold/VIX) into risk-asset positioning (stablecoin growth, funding, MVRV), so the statistically honest call is HOLD until the breaker fires.
next_move.brains_agree: Partially — both see the coil and the 2020 analog, but the analyst explicitly calls HOLD while the narrative writer's framing implies continuation is near; the analyst's higher trust weight and the absence of confirmed breakers settle the split toward HOLD.
next_move.confirmed_if: stablecoin_growth breaks above 60 AND funding rises above 65 with CVD_btc_pct_30d clearing 25 — showing capital deployment shifting from fear-hedge into risk-asset positioning
next_move.invalidated_if: VIX spikes above 80 OR btc_momentum_30d drops below 70 with exchange_netflow turning negative (inflows) — signaling risk-off rotation overwhelming the coil
